sql.scope: isolated in-memory PGlite actual SQL; no production connection

groups.name: fresh individual, waiting invite and private report
two existing waiting invites can join without losing either private answer
unknown target preserves the old empty invite
full target preserves the old empty invite
same owner secret cannot join a second personal result, empty invite survives
wrong owner key never changes a pair
established pair is immutable across other, unknown and self invite attempts
retry submit can join from an existing empty invite and keeps saved answers
SQL failure rolls back empty invite removal and attempted join atomically
many interleaved sequential pair orders preserve one pair membership
server controls exact seven day lifetime and sharing cannot extend it
delete immediately removes own payload and pair but preserves partner payload
deleting the partner also disconnects without erasing the inviting owner
deleted tombstone blocks delayed submit, pairing, report and sharing retries
expiry cuts all access before purge and does not silently renew a result
expired target never destroys an unrelated valid waiting invite
expired invite does not lose a newly saved personal result or poison retries
purge removes expired results and tombstones, preserves all live private results
all seven RPCs deny public, anonymous and authenticated execution
missing required questionnaire metadata fails the table check

limitations: One PGlite session cannot prove multi-session PostgreSQL blocking, races, lock timeouts or throughput.
